title: org-config-tools-v1
description: An org config carrying the tools v1 section, as pushed to the gateway. tools has no managed flag: the org's managed opt-in for paid capabilities is mcp.managed_tools, whose allow and deny globs take <capability>/<vendor> beside fagi.<id>/<tool>. The shape is the OrgConfig definition of the admin contract; this file only points at it. Resolve the reference by registering ../agentcc-admin.schema.json under its $id.
